title: Skald runtime spec, version 1
description: content_version.spec_json of a version Skald built (WORKPLAN-BUNDLES.md T9 (a)). Every value is the server's own record, derived at success from the build's provenance and the base catalog, never from the uploaded manifest. Facts of the image only: the image itself is stated once, in content_version.image (digest-pinned), and policy -- memory and CPU limits -- is the deployment's skald.runtime.* configuration, applied when the version is run. A version without a build (an admin's direct image) carries {} instead and is not judged by this schema. Released and immutable: a changed meaning is a new version, not an edit here.

port.description: The port the app listens on inside its container. Above 1023: the app runs as a non-root user, which cannot bind below.

user.description: uid:gid the container runs as: the base image's non-root user from the catalog. Never 0, and numeric only, so no name lookup inside the image decides it.

base.description: The catalog id of the base the image was built from (images/catalog.json).
